content:
当前工作区里已经放好了 2 份只读输入：
- `threads.json`
- `policy.yaml`

请根据 thread 上下文和 policy，创建 `recipient_decision.json`：
{
  "thread_id": "...",
  "selected_handle": "...",
  "selected_channel": "telegram",
  "rejected_candidates": ["..."],
  "reason": "..."
}

规则：
- 只能选择一个收件人
- 必须使用 last_confirmed_target 作为最终目标
- `rejected_candidates` 必须按字母序
- `reason` 必须明确说明为什么不能选另一个同名候选人
- 不要输出额外字段

我来先查看输入文件的内容。

<tool_call>
<command>读取 threads.json 文件</command>
<arguments>
{"name": "file_read", "arguments": {"path": "threads.json"}}
</arguments>
</tool_call>

<tool_result>
<name>file_read</name>
<output>
[threads.json] 共 14 行，显示第 1-14 行
   1 | {
   2 |   "threads": [
   3 |     {
   4 |       "thread_id": "t-100",
   5 |       "topic": "release approval follow-up",
   6 |       "recipient_candidates": [
   7 |         {"name": "Alex Chen", "handle": "@alex-release", "channel": "telegram", "team": "release"},
   8 |         {"name": "Alex Chen", "handle": "@alex-design", "channel": "telegram", "team": "design"}
   9 |       ],
  10 |       "last_confirmed_target": "@alex-release",
  11 |       "required_context": "release approval packet"
  12 |     }
  13 |   ]
  14 | }
</output>
</tool_result>

<tool_result>
<name>file_read</name>
<output>
[policy.yaml] 共 6 行，显示第 1-6 行
   1 | preferred_channels:
   2 |   @alex-release: telegram
   3 |   @alex-design: telegram
   4 | confirmation_policy:
   5 |   require_last_confirmed_target: true
   6 |   single_recipient_only: true
</output>
</tool_result>

现在分析数据并创建 `recipient_decision.json`：

1. 根据 `confirmation_policy` 中的 `require_last_confirmed_target: true`，必须使用 `last_confirmed_target` 作为最终目标，即 `@alex-release`
2. 两个候选人都叫 "Alex Chen"，但 handle 和 team 不同
3. 根据 `required_context: "release approval packet"` 和 `team: "release"`，应该选择 release 团队的 Alex
4. `rejected_candidates` 需要按字母序排序

让我创建输出文件：

<tool_call>
<command>创建 recipient_decision.json 文件</command>
<arguments>
{"name": "file_write", "arguments": {"path": "recipient_decision.json", "content": "{\n  \"thread_id\": \"t-100\",\n  \"selected_handle\": \"@alex-release\",\n  \"selected_channel\": \"telegram\",\n  \"rejected_candidates\": [\"@alex-design\"],\n  \"reason\": \"Policy requires using last_confirmed_target (@alex-release). Both candidates have the same name but different teams: @alex-release is from release team (matching required context 'release approval packet'), while @alex-design is from design team.\"\n}"}}
</arguments>
</tool_call>

<tool_result>
<name>file_write</name>
<output>
已写入 /Users/liuchen/Desktop/deepseek-cli/liuchen-best-cli/benchmark/results/run_20260525_162639/constraints_20_message_recipient_disambiguation_live/workspace/recipient_decision.json (7 行, 403 字节)
</output>
</tool_result>

已创建 `recipient_decision.json` 文件。根据 policy 要求，必须使用 `last_confirmed_target` 作为最终目标，选择了 `@alex-release`，拒绝了 `@alex-design`。理由是两个候选人虽然同名，但所属团队不同，且 `@alex-release` 来自 release 团队，与要求的上下文 "release approval packet" 匹配。
